points.description: States the core idea: repeatedly pick the minimum (smallest) element from the unsorted/remaining part of the array and place it in the next position at the front (first, then second, and so on).
points.partial_credit: Award about 2-3 marks if only half the idea is given, e.g. mentions finding the minimum/smallest element or swapping elements into position, but not the repeated process on the remaining part, or the placement into successive positions.

rubric.notes: Full marks for saying, in any wording, that it repeatedly finds the smallest remaining element and puts it in the next position from the front. Part marks for a vague or incomplete version, such as only finding the minimum or only swapping into place without the repetition. No marks for describing a different sort or unrelated points; extra correct detail is fine.
